Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. 2026-07-23: a failing RAGAS --rejudge on the claude-haiku CLI judge was relaunched three or four times as memory errors and CLI timeouts hit the artefact's oversized contexts, dressed up as bounded tests. Each relaunch was a COMPLETE judge run - about 100 questions x several LLM metrics x multiple headless-claude calls each - and strung together they burned the user's entire subscription usage window in minutes. When a claude-* run fails, STOP and diagnose from the output already on disk; do not relaunch to see if it works now. A retry is a fresh full-cost run, so estimate tokens x calls out loud and get an explicit go BEFORE EACH attempt, not just the first. 'Bounded test', 'one clean attempt' and 'one folder' are still full burns and are not free diagnostics. Reap process trees after any run. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.10 verdict: GROUNDED
